title: Revolutionizing CAD: Why CADCraft is the Open-Source AutoCAD Alternative You Need!
published: True
tags: cad, rust, opensource, autocad

## Quick Summary: 📝
CADCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of AutoCAD, built entirely in Rust. It aims to provide a fast and familiar CAD experience with features like command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, and hatches, running on multiple operating systems and the web.

## Key Takeaways: 💡

* ✅ CADCraft is an open-source, free alternative to AutoCAD, built from scratch in Rust.

* ✅ It offers a familiar workflow with features like command line, layers, object snaps, and DXF support.

* ✅ Leverages Rust for high performance, memory safety, and reliability in CAD applications.

* ✅ Runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, and even in the browser via WebAssembly.

* ✅ A community-driven project with immense potential for developers and designers to contribute and benefit.


## Project Statistics: 📊
* ⭐ **Stars:** 3845
* 🍴 **Forks:** 1758
* ❗ **Open Issues:** 138


## Tech Stack: 💻
- ✅ Rust


Are you tired of the hefty subscription fees and proprietary lock-in that come with traditional CAD software? Do you dream of a powerful, familiar design tool that's truly yours, running on any platform you choose? Well, fellow developers and designers, get ready to be excited because a game-changer has arrived on GitHub: CADCraft!CADCraft isn't just another CAD program; it's a bold, open-source clean-room reimplementation of Autodesk AutoCAD, rebuilt from the ground up in pure Rust. Imagine all the core functionalities you rely on – the command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks, and DXF drawing support – but now, it's completely open, free, and community-driven. This project aims to bring the robust and intuitive AutoCAD workflow we all know and love into the open-source world, without compromising on power or familiarity.One of the most exciting aspects of CADCraft is its foundation in Rust. For those unfamiliar, Rust is a programming language renowned for its performance, memory safety, and concurrency. This means CADCraft is designed to be incredibly fast, reliable, and efficient, handling complex designs without breaking a sweat. It's a modern approach to a classic problem, leveraging cutting-edge technology to deliver a superior user experience.And the accessibility? It's phenomenal! CADCraft runs natively across all major operating systems: macOS, Windows, Linux, and even FreeBSD. But wait, there's more – it also runs directly in your browser via WebAssembly! This cross-platform compatibility means you can work on your designs from virtually anywhere, on any device, without needing expensive licenses or specific hardware setups. This flexibility alone is a massive win for individual designers and small teams alike.For developers, the open-source nature of CADCraft opens up a world of possibilities. You can inspect the code, contribute to its development, and even build custom extensions or integrations tailored to your specific needs. This isn't just a tool; it's a platform that you can help shape and evolve. The ArtCraft team is fostering a vibrant community, inviting artists and creators from all backgrounds to join the conversation and contribute.In essence, CADCraft is poised to democratize computer-aided design. It offers a powerful, familiar, and free alternative to proprietary software, built with modern performance in mind and accessible across all platforms. While still in early development, its potential is immense, and it's definitely a project you'll want to keep an eye on – or even better, get involved with!
